subject: IAM evidence intake & vendor questionnaire kickoff — PrimeHealth
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Lucas Grant <lucas.grant@primehealth.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: IAM evidence intake & vendor questionnaire kickoff — PrimeHealth

Hi Lucas / PrimeHealth security team,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for the time. Quick written recap and proposed next steps so we can keep procurement on track.

Call highlights (from your side):
- SOC 2 status: you asked for evidence of Type II or an expected Type II completion date.
- Regulatory concerns: GDPR applicability + HIPAA / BAA question for any PHI handling.
- IAM: SSO (SAML) support and metadata, SCIM provisioning (group & role sync), RBAC/admin role definitions, audit log retention windows.
- Questionnaire: you prefer a filled vendor security questionnaire + supporting artifacts (reports, diagrams).

What we will provide:
1) Completed vendor questionnaire (attached stub: vendor-questionnaire-PrimeHealth.pdf).
2) SOC 2 summary document and expected Type II timeline (attached: redwood_soc2-summary.pdf).
3) Technical artifacts: SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml) and SCIM schema (scim-schema.json).
4) RBAC & admin controls summary (admin-controls-summary.pdf).

Timeline / asks
- Please confirm the deadline procurement needs this fully populated (what date do you need everything by?).
- If you need a signed BAA, flag that now so I can loop in Legal.
- Confirm whether you need an auditor contact or full SOC 2 report vs. summary.
- If possible, please upload your vendor questionnaire (we can fill in-line) — I included a blank copy attached but happy to use yours.

Next steps (our side):
- Rishi (cc'd) will share the SAML metadata and SCIM schema by Monday EOD 8/17 PT.
- Monica (cc'd) will follow up with SOC 2 timeline and the security/compliance contact for audit requests.
- I will complete the questionnaire and return a first pass by 8/20.

Attachments: vendor-questionnaire-PrimeHealth.pdf, redwood_soc2-summary.pdf

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

From: Lucas Grant <lucas.grant@primehealth.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: PrimeHealth Security Team <security@primehealth.io>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:21:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: IAM evidence intake & vendor questionnaire kickoff — PrimeHealth

Vanessa — thanks for the writeup and quick follow. A few clarifications so we can scope procurement: 

1) SOC 2: we require a Type II report where possible. If Type II is in progress, please include the expected completion month and the auditor firm. A summary PDF is helpful but procurement will often ask to see the auditor contact or a redacted report.

2) HIPAA / BAA: We handle limited PHI in our workflows; we need to know whether Redwood offers a BAA or has standard language. If you cannot sign a BAA, indicate the default protections and processes you have in place.

3) SAML / SCIM specifics:
   - SAML: we prefer IdP-initiated SSO; please confirm whether you support both IdP- and SP-initiated flows and provide metadata.
   - SCIM: must support group sync, SCIM v2, and role mapping (ability to assign Redwood roles via SCIM groups).

4) Test tenant: procurement will request a temporary test tenant or sandbox account with an API key to validate SCIM provisioning. Can you provide that (or call to walk through the flow)?

5) Questionnaire: attaching our vendor questionnaire — we've filled a few fields internally (attached: primehealth-vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf). If you can return a completed copy that is easiest for procurement.

Deadline: procurement is requesting completed materials by COB Mon 2026-08-23.

If you can get the SAML metadata and SCIM schema before EOD 8/17 that helps our engineers start checks.

Thanks — Lucas
Lucas Grant
Director, Infrastructure Security | PrimeHealth
lucas.grant@primehealth.io

(attachment: primehealth-vendor-security-questionnaire.pdf)

Action plan / owners:
- Rishi Malhotra (security engineer) — will provide SAML metadata (IdP + SP notes), SCIM v2 schema with group/role mapping examples, and a short runbook for provisioning. Expect saml-metadata.xml and scim-schema.json attached. Target: 2026-08-17 EOD PT.
- Monica Patel (security/compliance) — will provide SOC 2 status, auditor firm name, and whether we can provide a redacted report or auditor contact. Also to confirm BAA availability and next steps. Target: 2026-08-20.
- Vanessa (me) — will ingest your PDF and return a completed questionnaire by 2026-08-20 for procurement.

We can also stand up a 30-min technical sync with your engineers the week of 8/23 if you want to validate SCIM flows against a sandbox. Please advise preferred times.

Attachments planned: saml-metadata.xml, scim-schema.json, admin-controls-summary.pdf (first pass).

Thanks — will follow up when artifacts are uploaded to the Drive link.

Best,
Vanessa
